remarks:
Welcome to the historic Glenny Building in the heart of downtown Buffalo. This inviting ground floor condo offers convenient one level living with an impressive sense of space created by soaring ceilings and massive windows that fill the main living area with natural light. Much of the unit has been recently painted, creating a fresh and move in ready feel while maintaining the character of this distinctive building.
The open living and dining area flows naturally into the kitchen, which features white cabinetry, generous counter space, stainless steel appliances, and an eat in layout. Warm wood toned flooring carries throughout much of the home and complements the bright, clean interior. The spacious bedroom offers excellent closet space, while the full bathroom and in unit laundry add everyday convenience. The condo includes one bedroom, one full bathroom, approximately 725 square feet, central air conditioning, and no step entry. Located at 251 Main Street, the Glenny Building places you in the center of downtown with easy access to restaurants, entertainment, public transportation, and many of Buffalo's most recognizable destinations. Featuring Buffalo’s only iron clad exterior, this architecturally significant building is ready for you. The monthly association fee includes common area maintenance, common area taxes and insurance, common heating and cooling, exterior building maintenance, snow removal, and water and sewer.
A unique opportunity for convenient city living in one of downtown Buffalo's distinctive historic buildings.
